# Font data notices

The optional managed font assembly embeds numerical base-14 metric facts and standardized glyph/encoding identifiers. It contains original parser/subset code and no third-party implementation bodies or bundled font outlines.

`standard-data.json` records observed source/data hashes and tool versions. Adobe Glyph List mapping data retains its redistribution notice. Normative encoding identifiers observed from the independent font tools retain the accompanying permissive notices. The FontTools and encoding-data licenses apply to their respective data; they do not introduce runtime dependencies.

The small CJK font under the test fixture directory is separately SIL OFL licensed, renamed after modification, and accompanied by its exact source identity and complete notice. Original synthetic test font outlines are licensed with this repository. Test fixtures are not automatically selected for SDK output. Caller-provided font licenses and embedding restrictions must be reviewed for the caller's use. Final package/license/SBOM qualification remains required.
